newsitem.title: MEXICO: Hylsamex shareholders approve new issue.
newsitem.headline: Hylsamex shareholders approve new issue.

text.p: Shareholders of Mexican steel company Hylsamex S.A. on Friday approved a new share issue of 43 million of its benchmark B shares to be offered in Mexico and abroad, the company said.
"It was agreed to increase the company's share capital through the issue of 43 million B shares that will be placed among investors in Mexico and abroad," the company said in a statement.
The company said it would offer 24 million shares within the next few months and then offer an additional 19 million shares at an unspecified future date.
Hylsamex, a subsidiary of Mexican giant Alfa, had said it wanted to issue shares to raise at least $100 million to finance expansion plans.
However, the company said its planned investment of $210 million during 1997 and 1998 were not contingent on the share offer.
